findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold the ordinary penalty reading together with an image of the consequence as a severing act.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory severance metaphor, not the lexical definition of جَزَاؤُهُ and not a claim that the focus word means cutting in its ordinary legal use.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier has an exact focus cutting branch and exact pericope context roles, but it is legacy_unbound and explicitly exploratory.

findings.title: The recompense becomes a countermeasure
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the question asks what countermeasure can balance the lost measured object, with a person eventually occupying that exchange position.
findings.mechanism: The focus standing-in-place branch meets the measure word, the vessel, and the recovery load; the repeated recompense in 12:75 places the person at the end of that material balancing sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the focus question as part of an economy of measures in which a lost vessel, a load, and a human bearer occupy successive positions.
findings.containment: This is a material analogy, not literal commodification of the person and not a replacement for the ordinary question about penalty.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier supplies exact material carriers and a focus return, but the source is legacy_unbound and its mechanism is explicitly exploratory.

findings.title: A denial is tested by its ability to remain standing
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the conditional liar predicate can be felt as a denial whose apparent persistence is tested by search and finding until the claim stops holding.
findings.mechanism: The focus conditional and liar carrier meet the supplied stop-after-running and failure-to-continue branches, while the absence question at 12:71 and finding at 12:75 provide the inspection sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the conditional as a timed test: a denial remains in place until the controlled search reaches the point where evidence appears.
findings.containment: The ordinary meaning of liar remains intact. The continuance and stopping images are an exploratory procedural overlay, not a replacement definition of falsehood.

epistemic.reason: The outlier has exact focus branch records for the two كذب collocations and كَوْن, plus exact context carriers for absence and finding; the HFT source remains legacy_unbound.
